evidence_detail: R227 (eps=36.1) FAILS ON SOURCE TYPE, NOT ON VALUE. PROVENANCE: 0 of 2065 ledger rows carry GAEKPEKOJKCEMS-UHFFFAOYSA-N and 0 ledger rows cite 10.1016/j.isci.2026.115778, so the number cannot be reproduced from any observation. DOI RESOLVES: Crossref + EuropePMC confirm Sun AY, Simi NL, Pol VG, iScience 2026;29(5):115778, published 2026-04-17, PMC13156642, PMID 42111170. The future-looking identifier is REAL, not hallucinated - this attack fails. BUT pubTypeList=['review-article','Review'] and the article self-describes as 'this review'/'this perspective': it is a SECONDARY compilation, so its 'Table 3' is a literature value with an unstated primary origin. The project already labels it source_quality='open_access_review_table', evidence_level='open_access_review_table' - it is a secondary source BY ITS OWN METADATA. The primary leg it cites is R248's own Segato 2021 paper, so R227 is not an independent second measurement. TEMPERATURE IS FABRICATED: temperature_source='review_table_standard_room_temperature' - 298.15 K is a convention, not a measured condition; uncertainty field is empty (no uncertainty at all). SECOND ADVERSARIAL FINDING: gap_aggregation_audit.csv records v04_epsilon=36.9 for this same EPSV04-R227 row (gap_epsilon=36.1), i.e. the audit table has silently replaced R227's value with R248's. This is the 3rd of only 3 such disagreements in 248 rows (the other two, R166/R174, are provable stereo-sibling mis-joins on the same InChIKey first block). The provenance evidence for this row is therefore self-contradictory. ADMISSIBILITY: no primary measurement, no measured temperature, no uncertainty, secondary source, and a contradictory audit trail. No counter-evidence search could rehabilitate it because there is no primary datum to rehabilitate.

R248 (eps=36.9) IS THE STRONGER LEG BUT STILL INADMISSIBLE AS A MEASUREMENT. PROVENANCE: 0 of 2065 ledger rows carry this compound or cite 10.1016/j.ica.2021.120372. DOI RESOLVES: Crossref confirms Segato J, Baratta W, Belanzoni P, Belpassi L, Del Zotto A, Zuccaccia D, Inorganica Chimica Acta 2021;522:120372 - a real, published article (created 2021-03-30, published 2021-07). This attack also fails. BUT IT IS THE WRONG KIND OF PAPER: the title is 'Experimental and theoretical investigation of the cycloisomerization of N-propargylcarboxamide catalyzed by NHC-Au-X in green solvents'. It is a homogeneous gold-catalysis paper that uses GVL as a reaction medium; the dielectric constant is incidental, appears only in 'supporting information', and its 113 references are all Au-catalysis/green-chemistry work with no dielectric-constant study. The value is therefore a METHODS-TABLE CITATION, not a reported dielectric measurement. The project's 'source_quality=primary' label is an inference from 'this is a research article', not evidence that a permittivity was measured. TEMPERATURE IS ABSENT: temperature_source='not_reported'. The 298.15 K on the row is an IMPUTATION by the queue, not a reported condition - the project's own notes state 'neither leg carries a measurement temperature'. ORIGIN IS NOT INDEPENDENT: the row entered the project through a restricted Reaxys queue row (probes/reaxys_dielectric_queue_first_cut.csv, queue_rank 3) that carried NO DOI and a WRONG InChIKey (JYVATQXCHBTGRN-UHFFFAOYSA-N, which the project itself proved returns 0 substances/0 documents). The DOI was attached afterwards by Crossref lookup. So the provenance chain is: Reaxys record -> unverified DOI attachment -> assumed temperature. ADMISSIBILITY: the best available lead, but a value in an SI table of an unrelated catalysis paper, with no stated temperature, reached through a mis-keyed restricted intermediary. It is not an admissible primary measurement, though it is closer than R227.
